LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingsNeedsColdStorage: Needs Cold Storage. Applies at once.
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingCarbonPressDesc: Off: the press leaves the build menu and its bills stop. Built presses and packs stay; packs keep their food.
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingCarbonShockDesc: Each meal thawed out of a carbonite pack may come out carbon-burnt: edible, tastes of metal, a small bad thought. Raw food never burns.
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingPreservationRequiredD: On: canon dishes need their preserved ingredient (the carbonite 'n' cream pie needs blast-chilled cream). Off: each such dish also gets a bill that takes fresh ingredients. Applies at once.
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingVceReskin: Ration-sealer names for Vanilla Cooking Expanded
LanguageData.RSW_Cuisine_SettingVceReskinDesc: On: the canning machine reads as a ration sealer and its cans as sealed ration tins. Names only; nothing changes how they work. Needs a restart.
